question: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word: **CHICANERY**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Deception**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"CHICANERY"** refers to the use of trickery or deception to achieve a purpose, often in legal, political, or business matters. (छल कपट)
 
 
• **Example:** The politician was accused of chicanery for misleading the public with false promises.
 
 
• **"Deception"** means the act of deceiving someone by hiding the truth or giving a false impression, typically for personal gain. (धोखा)
 
 
• **Example:** His deception led everyone to believe he was an expert in the field, but he lacked actual knowledge.
 
 
• Hence, chicanery directly aligns with deception in meaning.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Deception**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Truth** (सत्य): Something that is factual and conforms to reality.
 
 
• **Example:** The truth about the incident was finally revealed after the investigation.
 
 
 
 
• **Honesty** (ईमानदारी): The quality of being truthful, sincere, and free from deceit.
 
 
• **Example:** His honesty earned him the respect of his colleagues.
 
 
 
 
• **Loyalty** (वफादारी): The quality of being faithful and committed to someone or something.
 
 
• **Example:** Her loyalty to her friends was evident during difficult times.
